title: How a Toaster Works in 60 Seconds 🍞🔥 #shorts
description:
There's no fire inside your toaster. Thin nichrome wires glow orange hot, an electromagnet holds your bread down, infrared heat browns it through the Maillard reaction, and a spring pops it up when the timer cuts the power. Glow, hold, brown, pop. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#toaster #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: The Toaster
steps.text: There is no fire inside your toaster. Just *wire*, glowing orange hot.

steps.label: Nichrome Wire
steps.text: Push the lever, and electricity rushes into thin *nichrome* wires. They resist the current so strongly that they heat up and glow.

steps.label: The Magnet
steps.text: Why does the lever stay down? A small *electromagnet* grabs it and holds your bread in place.

steps.label: Browning
steps.text: The glowing wires blast *infrared* heat at the bread. Above about 140 degrees, sugars and proteins turn *brown*.

steps.label: The Timer
steps.text: A little *timer* circuit counts down. When time is up, it cuts power to the magnet.

steps.label: Pop!
steps.text: Let go, and a *spring* launches your toast. Glow, hold, brown, pop. Follow Inside 60 for more.
